disclaimer: Forward-looking targets from Red Hat Product Management's Q3 2026 What's New & What's Next deck. Subject to change; not shipped fact.

targets.title: NeMo Guardrails expansion
targets.detail: Guardrails integration with AI Gateway/MaaS, Responses and Messages API support, MCP server guardrails, source-app based selection, standalone guardrail runtime with rails catalog.

targets.title: EvalHub GA UI
targets.detail: New GA EvalHub UI with Evaluation Gallery, GA adapters (Inspect AI, Garak, LightEval, RAGAS, GuideLLM, IBM CLEAR), sandboxed adversarial evaluations.

targets.title: MCP Lifecycle Operator GA
targets.detail: MCP Lifecycle, MCP Gateway Operator, and MCP Catalog support-tier labeling all targeted TP -> GA in 3.6.

targets.title: AutoML and AutoRAG reach GA
targets.detail: Both promoted TP -> GA targeted for RHAI 3.6.

targets.title: Kueue deepening
targets.detail: KServe workload preemption (GPU-as-a-Service), org-to-team quota tree UI, Topology Aware Scheduling, per-tenant GPU usage export for showback.

targets.title: llm-d enhancements
targets.detail: Fast model server startup (reduced cold starts), multi-cluster routing, Rust-based front-end for high-throughput low-latency inference.

targets.title: vLLM Omni TP
targets.detail: Any-to-any multimodal serving with ~200ms E2E latency voice intelligence, one container for any modality.

targets.title: AI Gateway Praxis data plane
targets.detail: Replaces fragmented Envoy + IPP + shim stacks with one governed hop for MaaS control plane. BREAKING -- plan migration.

targets.title: Notebooks 2.0 TP
targets.detail: WorkspaceKind-based next-gen workbench model. BREAKING change planned -- migration path from Notebooks 1.x being defined.

targets.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin accelerator enablement
targets.detail: New GPU generation support targeted for 3.6.

targets.title: RHOAI on Hosted Control Planes multi-tenancy
targets.detail: Fractional GPU sharing (vGPU/MIG) on HCP-on-Virtualization tenant clusters; per-tenant GPU usage/metering reference architecture.
